steps.title: Prepare and Thaw Blood Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare the blood samples and the initial lysis tube.

substeps.instruction: Preheat water bath to 37 °C before removing whole blood samples from -80°C freezer.
Thaw whole blood samples by gently agitating sample in the 37°C water bath.
Once thawed, reset water bath to 65 °C for the final step of the protocol.
Add 9 mL (1:3) RBC Lysis Solution to a 15 mL centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Initial Lysis and Incubation
steps.instruction: Combine blood with lysis solution and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 mL whole blood to the tube and mix by inverting 10 times.
Incubate sample for 00:05:00 at Room temperature (15°C-25°C), inverting once during incubation.

steps.title: Isolate White Blood Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge and resuspend the blood cell pellet.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 2000 x g, 25 °C, for 2 minutes.
Pour off and discard supernatant, leaving approximately 200 µL of residual liquid and the white blood cell pellet.
Vortex tube on high speed to resuspend pellet in the residual liquid.

steps.title: Cell Lysis
steps.instruction: Lyse the cells and ensure homogeneity.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 mL (1:1) Cell Lysis Solution.
Vortex on high speed for 00:00:10.
If clumps are visible, incubate sample in 37°C water bath until homogenous.

steps.title: Protein Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate proteins and pellet them via centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL (1:.333) of Protein Precipitation Solution.
Vortex on high speed for 00:00:20.
Centrifuge sample at 2000 x g, 25 °C, for 5 minutes.
If pellet does not tightly stick to the bottom, incubate on ice for 5 min and repeat centrifugation.
Add 3 mL (1:1) isopropanol into a clean 15 mL tube.
Carefully pour the supernatant from the previous step into this tube, ensuring the pellet is not dislodged.
Invert samples 50 times until DNA is visible as threads or a clump.
Centrifuge tube at 2000 x g, 3 minutes (temperature not specified), and observe DNA as a small white pellet.

steps.title: DNA Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet with ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Carefully pour/pipette off supernatant without disturbing the pellet; drain excess drops by inverting on a Kimwipe.
Add 3 mL (1:1) 70% ethanol and invert 3-5 times to wash the DNA pellet.
Centrifuge pellet at 2000 x g, 25 °C, for 1 minute.
Carefully pour/pipette off ethanol without disturbing the pellet; drain excess drops by inverting on a Kimwipe.

steps.title: Drying and Reconstitution
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet and dissolve the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Air dry the pellet for 00:01:00 (do not over-dry or under-dry).
Add 250 µL (1:100) DNA Hydration Solution.
Vortex on medium speed for 00:00:05.
Incubate DNA in 65 °C water bath for 01:00:00 to dissolve DNA.
Incubate at Room temperature (25°C) overnight on a rocker.

steps.title: Aliquotting and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Divide the DNA into aliquots for storage and analysis.

substeps.instruction: Transfer DNA to a 1.5 mL tube and split volume in half to create two aliquots (DNA0-01 and 02).
Aliquot 3 µL (40x dilution) DNA into a 1.5 mL tube for Cary concentration assay (store at -20 °C if not assayed immediately).
Aliquot 1.5 µL DNA into a PCR tube for .7% agarose gel electrophoresis to confirm presence and size (store at -20 °C if not assayed immediately).
